The idea

Clay is more than material. It is livelihood, culture, and climate action in one form.

ClayBay gives skilled artisans a wider platform while offering people a practical alternative to plastic-heavy, mass-produced goods — starting with simple products, strong storytelling, and zero-loss onboarding for makers.

The core thought

ClayBay turns traditional pottery into a modern sustainable brand, where every product carries utility, culture, and livelihood impact.

The people behind it

Shiven Shukla leads the idea and Manas Singh joins as co-founder to help shape the brand, community, and launch direction.

What launches first

Kulhads, diyas, cups, mini planters, bowls, and gifting sets are planned for cafes, homes, festivals, and partnerships.

Interactive craft

Visitors can play pottery-themed games that make the website more memorable while staying connected to the ClayBay story.

The idea

Clay is livelihood, culture and climate action in one form.

ClayBay gives skilled artisans a wider platform while offering people a practical alternative to plastic-heavy, mass-produced goods. The brand begins with simple products, strong storytelling, and zero-loss onboarding for makers, then grows into a community around sustainable craft.

Products can be offered in natural clay, matte finish, glazed colour, hand-painted artwork or limited-edition artisan patterns. Customization can include names, café logos, corporate branding, wedding themes, festival motifs, colour matching, engraved patterns, custom shapes and branded packaging.

Handling & packaging

Every ClayBay product should reach the customer looking as carefully made as it was crafted: inspect it, clean it, protect it, label it clearly, and present it beautifully.

Product handling SOP

  1. 1Quality inspection: check shape, cracks, chips, firing, finish, colour and dimensions before packing.
  2. 2Gentle cleaning: remove dust naturally and ensure the product is completely dry before packaging.
  3. 3Safe handling: use clean hands and never stack fragile pieces directly against one another.
  4. 4Protective packing: wrap each fragile piece individually and fill empty space so nothing moves.
  5. 5Final check: verify product, quantity, label, care card and order details before sealing.
  6. 6Storage: keep finished products in a dry, protected environment until dispatch.

Packaging system

Single Product Box

Individual products and premium gifting.

Multi-Product Box

Curated sets, café orders and combinations.

Corporate Box

Premium branded presentation for corporate and event gifting.

Bulk Transport Box

Reinforced cartons with internal separators for B2B shipments.

Kraft cardboard boxes, honeycomb or kraft-paper protection, paper tape and recyclable inserts wherever practical. Every package carries the ClayBay logo, tagline, product name, material, artisan-made message, care instructions, origin and a QR code linking to the product or artisan story.

Interactive craft

Play with clay

Three small games that keep the ClayBay story memorable — patience at the wheel, reflexes in the workshop, and a steady hand at the coil tower.

Shape the perfect pot

Match the target silhouette by tuning the clay's height, belly, neck and rim. A cleaner match earns a higher craft score.

Ready

Start shaping the clay.

Smash the clay

A 30-second arcade round in the workshop.

Stack the coils

Drop each sliding coil of clay onto the one below. Overhang gets trimmed, so precision builds the tallest pot.

Press Start Stack

Coils of clay slide across the wheel. Click, tap or press space to drop each one — any overhang is trimmed away, so keep the tower centred.

Operating model

How ClayBay moves from craft to community

A practical path from sourcing to sales, designed to support makers while building demand.

1

Source responsibly

Find eco-friendly clay sources and connect with potters who can grow with the brand.

2

Make with assurance

Bring artisans into business with clarity, fair pricing, and a zero-loss mindset.

3

Create digital buzz

Use social media, e-commerce, local stores, exhibitions, and storytelling campaigns.

4

Scale step by step

Grow from kulhads and diyas into mugs, bowls, decor, gifting sets, and partnerships.
